links.comparator_used: Same LLMs prompted without guideline-based prompting (generic prompt relying on built-in knowledge)
links.outcome: Consistency/agreement of LLM-computed Charlson Comorbidity Index with expert consensus
links.effect: Structured prompting 'further improved consistency'; no numeric effect for the with-vs-without comparison reported in the abstract (overall best agreement across models: R² up to 0.93, Cohen's κ up to 0.75)
links.quote: Open-source and proprietary systems achieved comparable accuracy, and structured prompting further improved consistency.
